title: Clevatess II: Majuu no Ou to Itsuwari no Yuusha Denshou

thread.title: Clevatess Season 2 • Clevatess II: Majuu no Ou to Akago to Shikabane no Yuusha Denshou - Episode 13 discussion - FINAL

opinions.point: Most commenters considered the finale highly entertaining, praising its intensity, emotional impact, humor, and strong setup for a continuation.
Several commenters highlighted the action and visual spectacle, especially the climactic combat and Alicia’s power-up.
Alicia was repeatedly praised as a compelling, resilient protagonist, while the princess’s character development also received favorable attention.
The ending generated substantial excitement and anticipation, but many commenters were frustrated or stunned by how abruptly it left major questions unresolved.
A minority felt the episode was rushed, with some major confrontations resolved too quickly or without enough dramatic payoff.
